notes.notes:

- Made some special weapons not be affected by speed factors, like Fire Shield and Spike Ball, which are made of constant projectiles.
- Made Spike Ball slightly weaker.

notes.title: Content update: new hero, new powerups, new skills, new artifacts! Also, mounts!
notes.notes:
Finally, we can ride chickens to battle!

This update introduce a new Hero, the Beastmaster!
This hero can capture enemies with his whip and mount them for special bonuses and damage reduction.

In addition we added option to buy gems for gold, new powerups, skills, artifacts and more.

Full changes:

- Added class: 'Beastmaster'.
- Added skills: 'Whip', 'Bear Trap', 'Spirit Wolf'.
- Added enemies: 'Wolf'.
- Added extra level to many powerups with a very expensive price.
- Added mount mechanism (currently just for Beastmaster).
- Added Artifacts: 'Full Plate', 'Golden Full Plate', 'Blood Armor', 'Cooked Beans'.
- Some powerups price adjustments.
- Added powerups: 'Arachnophobia', 'Trapper', 'Cannibalism', 'Rider'.
- Added option to purchase Gems in powerups store.
- Added boss slaying record times to game stats.
- Made 'Sigil Of Trapping' deliver less damage, but target up to 3 enemies.
- Changed stamina bar color and slightly adjusted it.
- Vampire bat form will now ignore puddles, spider webs and floor hazards.
- Nerfed weapons: 'Chackram', 'Balls of Steel'.
- Improved weapons: 'Bolas', 'Boomerang'.
- Some other minor balances.
- Added graphic indicator when you're affected by spider webs.
- Made summoned minions ignore gates and walls.
- Fixed minions quirk where they get locked on a far away enemy and then walk back and forth.
- Made HUD elements a bit smaller to include mount health when needed.

notes.title: Small improvements and bugfix from players input
notes.notes:
Minor fixes from players feedback

- Fixed the flickering in the powerups menu.
- Made the wanderer slower when you fall behind + added clearer visual indicator of danger when you stray too far.
- Added an option to refund powerups in exchange of gems.
- Added 500 gold compensation if player finds an artifact they already own.

If you requested something and I didn't reply at all or said I'll do it and its not here - please give me a reminder!

Thanks :)

notes.title: Small polishing update! + Integration with Steam
notes.notes:
Added the following:

- Save record time for completing missions.
- Added 'Last Resort' powerup.
- Made Powerups menu scroll be like with other menus (mousewheel / up-down keys) and not annoying like it was.
- Menus scroll and height adjustments.

Important Notes! 

I added integration code with steam as prep to add steam achievements and other stuff.  It should continue to work with or without steam, if you're having problems in this aspect please let me know.
Controllers still don't work due to a bug with WebView2 (a Windows component I use). I contacted Microsoft on GitHub and they are aware and working on a fix. I hope they will release an update soon.
